text: AAK STATEMENT ON AVERTING THE LOOMING ENVIRONMENTAL CRISIS Dear Member, Attached herein is the Architectural Association of Kenya’s Statement on the widespread destruction of trees and environmental degradation across the country.

images.alt: Page 1 of AAK's statement on averting the looming environmental crisis, for immediate release, 16 October 2026
Page 2 of the statement, signed by George A. Ndege, President, Architectural Association of Kenya

text: The Architectural Association of Kenya proudly congratulates our members on their election as Section Member Representatives for Kenya in the East Africa Institute of Architects (EAIA) for the term 2026-2027. This is a significant achievement and a proud moment for the Association, as our members take up key leadership roles to represent Kenya and advance the architectural profession across the East African region. We wish them a successful and impactful term.

images.alt: AAK congratulates the members elected as Section Member Representatives for Kenya in the East Africa Institute of Architects (EAIA) for 2026–2027

text: The Architectural Association of Kenya is proud of Fredrick Warega, Deputy Director, Physical and Land Use Planning, County Government of Homa Bay and Rex Otieno Omondi, Urban Policy Analyst, Akiba Mashinani Trust, for winning the 2026 IHS Alumni Impact Award at Erasmus University Rotterdam, the Netherlands. They were awarded for their project, People’s Adaptation – Local Physical and Land Use Development Plan for Homa Bay Municipality 2025–2035, which champions community-led planning and climate resilience. Congratulations to both Fredrick Warega and Rex Otieno!

images.alt: Congratulations card: Fredrick Warega and Rex Otieno Omondi, winners of the 2026 IHS Alumni Impact Award at Erasmus University Rotterdam

text: Congratulations to Arch. Florence Nyole, M.A.A.K (A) on her election as the Vice President, Commonwealth Association of Architects (CAA) Region V (Africa) 2026-2028. This prestigious appointment is a testament to her leadership, dedication to the profession, and commitment to promoting excellence in the built environment. AAK is immensely proud and we wish her all the best in this new role.

images.alt: Congratulations card: Arch. Florence Nyole, M.A.A.K (A), elected Vice President, Commonwealth Association of Architects (CAA) Region V (Africa) 2026–2028
